summary:
Coinbase is the crypto exchange at coinbase.com. The blue circle in the tab is the icon account bookmarks request, saved from the host response.

Checked 12 November 2026 against coinbase.com. HTML came from https://www.coinbase.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://coinbase.com/favicon.ico returned png (32×32, 870 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://coinbase.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 512×512 png.

Brand colour #2277bb comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-512x512-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-512x512-01.png at 512×512 (png, 14776 bytes) from https://coinbase.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
